name: gaudi
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  # The autotick bot bumps versions by substituting the literal current version
  # string in this file, so `version` has to be the literal and `tag` derived
  # from it. With the dependency the other way round no substitution happens and
  # no version PR is ever opened.
  version: "40.6"
  tag: ${{ "v" ~ (version | replace(".", "r")) }}

package:
  name: gaudi
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://gitlab.cern.ch/gaudi/Gaudi/-/archive/${{ tag }}/Gaudi-${{ tag }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 674b7f4063f6cb4678e92ffad8e11bd5c25523efc42eb4b66b20c539ed6844dc
  patches:
    # gaudi/Gaudi!1925 added getDefaultPluginPath() and wired it into
    # loadPluginLibrary() but not Registry::initialize(), so in a Conda env
    # with no GAUDI_PLUGIN_PATH / (DY)LD_LIBRARY_PATH the factory registry
    # initialises empty and lookups (e.g. EvtDataSvc) fail. Pending upstream
    # fix to be submitted as a follow-up to !1925.
    - patches/0001-fix-scan-default-plugin-path-in-Registry-initialize.patch
    # pytest 9 removed the startdir argument from the pytest_report_header
    # hookspec, so Gaudi's ctest_measurements_reporter plugin fails pluggy's
    # hookimpl validation and every ctest-driven pytest run aborts. Pending
    # submission upstream.
    - patches/0002-fix-drop-removed-startdir-arg-from-pytest_report_hea.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win
    # Skip macOS for now due to lack of upstream support
    - osx
    # conda-forge Python lacks gdbm support, so dbm.sqlite3 (Python 3.13+) is needed for confdb2
    - match(python, "<3.13")
  script:
    - |
      cmake ${CMAKE_ARGS} \
          -GNinja \
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
          -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$PREFIX \
          -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON \
          -DCMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES=OFF \
          -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
          -DGAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR=$SP_DIR \
          -DGAUDI_DEFAULT_PLUGIN_PATH=$PREFIX/lib \
          -DPython_EXECUTABLE=$PYTHON \
          -DGAUDI_USE_DOXYGEN=OFF \
          -S $SRC_DIR \
          -B build
      cmake --build build --parallel ${CPU_COUNT}
    - which ps
    # Exclude cmake.test_dummyGaudiDownstreamProject - requires vdt/ROOT
    # development dependencies not available in test install environmet
    # Exclude whiteboard.test_bug_cfhep114 - the reproducer requests a thread
    # pool of 10 with cardinality 10 and consistently exceeds its 120s timeout
    # under the oversubscription of a resource-constrained CI runner
    # Gaudi tests are flaky on resource constrained environments to retry up to three times
    - ctest --output-on-failure -E 'cmake\.test_dummyGaudiDownstreamProject|whiteboard\.test_bug_cfhep114' --repeat until-pass:3 -j${CPU_COUNT} --test-dir build
    - cmake --install build
    - root -l -b -q -e 'if (TClass::GetClass("DataObject") == nullptr) { std::cerr << "Failed to load DataObject" << std::endl; return 1; } return 0;'

requirements:
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("gaudi", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    # Gaudi looks zstd up with pkg_check_modules, not find_package
    - pkg-config
    # Gaudi invokes git at build/test time, and ps (procps-ng on linux) when
    # running its test suite
    - git
    - if: linux
      then: procps-ng
  host:
    # Gaudi's ctest suite drives pytest, so these are needed for the
    # build-time test run
    - python
    - pytest
    - pytest-cov
    - coverage
    - pyyaml
    - networkx
    - libboost-devel
    - libboost-python-devel
    - root_base
    - root_cxx_standard
    - tbb-devel
    - zlib
    - zstd
    - libuuid
    - range-v3
    - nlohmann_json
    - fmt
    - clhep
    - xerces-c
    - catch2
    - ms-gsl
    - aida
    - heppdt
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - GaudiKernel
      # Gaudi does not currently install Python package metadata, so pip_check
      # would fail
      pip_check: false
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - Gaudi
  - script:
      - Gaudi --help
      - gaudirun.py

about:
  homepage: https://gitlab.cern.ch/gaudi/Gaudi
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: The Gaudi software framework for event data processing applications
  description: |
    Gaudi is a software framework used for building event data processing
    applications in high-energy physics. It provides a component model,
    an event data model, and interfaces for tools, services, and algorithms.
    Originally developed at CERN for the LHCb experiment, it is now used
    by multiple experiments including ATLAS and LHCb.
  documentation: https://gaudi-framework.readthedocs.io/
  repository: https://gitlab.cern.ch/gaudi/Gaudi

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chrisburr
